items.name: Cube Against Cancer Hawaii 2027
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDgyNDQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d739808be3a2373fd1129978150c3798d3405ee0/IMG_1309.png) ### Oahu's annual winter competition is here! --- * It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. * Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need. * If you are a first time competitor it is highly encouraged to be present for the competitor tutorial at 9:50 AM. --- **This competition is a part of the [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.cubeagainstcancer.org/) competition series in collaboration with [Ethan's Ohana](https://www.ethansohana.org/). We are asking that all competitors bring at least one unopened 3x3 cube or STEM-related item, which will be donated to [Kapiʻolani Medical Center for Women & Children](https://www.hawaiipacifichealth.org/locations/kapiolani/). See the [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeAgainstCancerHawaii2027#83173-cube-against-cancer) tab for more information.** ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbEF2IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8251573b328b2e062c683f33bccc9e924b923d20/170aa7c0467a35c79617e6895b87b17f34553486.png)

items.information: ### Davis' second ever competition featuring *all blindfolded events*, plus OH! Don't DNF! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTMyODc3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--43a4741aef31f26a98dc1e8b9ffd2345e0737df2/image.png) ##### This competition will be specializing in quiet events and will not have 3x3 or typical events found in traditional competitions. - All attendees under the age of 18 are required to be accompanied by a parent or guardian. - Competition attendees may **appear on livestream and media**. - Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. items.name: Goethe-Institut Lima Open 2027
items.information: **Español** ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjMzNDI3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--158b0010028c6bb51d81743dd2195ed9f1227a33/Flag_of_Peru.png) Primera competencia del 2027 para Lima. Agradecemos al [Goethe-Institut Peru](https://www.goethe.de/ins/pe/es/index.html) por facilitarnos sus instalaciones para la realizacion de este evento. El [Goethe-Institut](https://www.goethe.de/ins/pe/es/index.html) es la institución cultural de la República Federal de Alemania en el mundo. Promueven el conocimiento del idioma alemán en el extranjero y fomentan la cooperación cultural internacional. Seguir las siguientes recomendaciones: Ver la pestaña ["Competidores"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GoetheInstitutLimaOpen2027#83301-competidores-competitors) para obtener información muy importante. Además, todos los competidores deben conocer el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) **Deutsch** ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjMzNDI4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b0c9e2278976a412e04c6e6232bdb07273765d92/Flag_of_Germany.png) Erster Wettbewerb des Jahres 2027 in Lima. Wir danken dem [Goethe-Institut Peru](https://www.goethe.de/peru) dafür, dass es uns freundlicherweise seine Räumlichkeiten für diesen Wettbewerb zur Verfügung stellt. Das [Goethe-Institut](https://www.goethe.de/peru) ist das weltweit tätige Kulturinstitut der Bundesrepublik Deutschland. Sie fördern die Kenntnis der deutschen Sprache im Ausland und unterstützen die internationale kulturelle Zusammenarbeit. Beachte die folgenden Empfehlungen: Wichtige Informationen finden Sie im Reiter [„Competitors“](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GoetheInstitutLimaOpen2027#83301-competidores-competitors). Zudem sollten alle Teilnehmenden mit den [WCA-Regeln](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/german/) vertraut sein. **English** ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjM0MDkxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3451c7107729cbe5a3cd2e1e1607c7b8765f2780/500px-Flag_of_the_United_Kingdom_(1-2).png) First competition of 2027 in Lima. We thank the [Goethe-Institut Peru](https://www.goethe.de/peru) for kindly letting us use their premises for this competition. The [Goethe-Institut](https://www.goethe.de/peru) is the cultural institution of the Federal Republic of Germany worldwide. They promote knowledge of the German language abroad and foster international cultural cooperation. Follow the recommendations below: See the ["Competitors"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GoetheInstitutLimaOpen2027#83301-competidores-competitors) tab for very important information. Also, all competitors should be aware of the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjM0MDcyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a69a37d78f835ef9494ddbf2297654cf3c741fd5/5.1.%20WCA.png)

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjI3ODY3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4726b9cd16b0c92a8a430c0067767c19976ea5e3/logo.jpeg) # **MICHOACUBO FTO 2027** **Español** Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la **Asociación Mundial de Cubos**. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉https://www.amscubing.org/aviso-de-privacidad **English** This competition is recognized as an official competition of the **World Cube Association**. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the[ WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) prior to competition. Come and cube with us in the beautiful city of Morelia, Michoacan, known for its pink quarry stone. It's a small tournament, but with great enthusiasm to continue growing our wonderful community. **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 https://www.amscubing.org/aviso-de-privacidad
